description: Server-side Razor rendering and HTML→PDF conversion. Razor rendering uses `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web.HtmlRenderer`; PDF conversion is driven by **PuppeteerSharp** against a locally-installed Chromium/Chrome browser.

sections.title: `IWebRendererService` methods
sections.text: Three families of operations sit on the service, plus three observability events.

sections.title: Render Razor components to HTML
rows: HTML string for component `T : IComponent`. Generic, `Type`, and FullName-string overloads share one code path (`LyoTypeInfo.TryResolveClrType`).
HTML string that passes a strongly-typed options object as the `Options` parameter.

sections.title: Turn HTML into PDF
rows: PDF bytes from an HTML string.
PDF bytes from an HTML file on disk.
End-to-end file → file (PDF path defaults to `<htmlFilePath>.pdf` when null).
sections.trail: > Only Razor render and HTML→PDF are on the current interface; there is no in-process screenshot API. For raw screenshots, use PuppeteerSharp directly through `BrowserExePath`.

sections.title: Events
sections.text: `ComponentRenderedToBytes`, `ComponentRendered`, `ComponentSavedToFile` fire after the matching render operations and carry the resulting payload plus parameter and options snapshots, used for archival or diffing.

sections.title: Options ([`WebRenderOptions`](WebRenderOptions.cs))
rows: Chromium/Chrome executable path PuppeteerSharp uses for HTML→PDF.
When `true` and an `IMetrics` is registered, records timers/counters/gauges (see below).
sections.trail:
The service uses `NullMetrics.Instance` when `EnableMetrics` is `false` (default), so registering `IMetrics` is optional.

Metrics emitted (see [`Constants.cs`](Constants.cs)) include `webrenderer.render_to_html(.bytes|_to_file).{duration,success,failure,size_bytes}` and
`webrenderer.convert_html_to_pdf.{duration,success,failure,size_bytes,input_size_bytes}`, tagged with `component_type` / `operation`.

sections.title: Register in DI ([`Extensions.cs`](Extensions.cs))
sections.text: The `WebRenderOptions` configuration section is bound, then a scoped `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web.HtmlRenderer` (host `IServiceProvider` and `ILoggerFactory`) and a scoped `IWebRendererService` → `WebRendererService` are registered. Registered `ILogger<WebRendererService>` and `IMetrics` are consumed when present. `configSectionName` selects a non-default section. There is no inline-options overload. To skip configuration binding, register `WebRenderOptions` yourself before the extension runs.
